'''Jan Dean Miller''' is an American engineer, currently Distinguished Professor of [[metallurgical engineering]] and Ivor D. Thomas Endowed Chair at [[University of Utah]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://faculty.utah.edu/u0028709-JAN_D_MILLER/biography/index.hml |title=Jan D. Miller |publisher=utah.edu |accessdate=March 6, 2017}}</ref>

==Biography==
Miller received his B.S. degree from the [[Pennsylvania State University]] in 1964, and his M.S. and Ph.D. degrees from the [[Colorado School of Mines]] in 1966 and 1969 respectively. He joined the faculty at the University of Utah in 1968, became a full professor in 1978, a distinguished professor in 2008 and served as chair of the Department of Metallurgical Engineering from 2002–2013. In 1993, he was elected a member the [[National Academy of Engineering]] for contributions to the fundamental theory and practical technology of flotation, mineral processing, and hydrometallurgy.<ref>{{cite web|title=Dr. Jan D. Miller|url=https://www.nae.edu/29981.aspx|website=National Academy of Engineering|accessdate=19 March 2017}}</ref> In 2022 he became a member of the [https://www.utahaes.org Utah Academy of Engineering and Science]. He holds more than 30 [[patents]] on methods for processing [[oil sands]], resin recovery from Utah coal, and air-sparged [[hydrocyclone]] technology, and has received many professional society awards from the [[American Institute of Mining, Metallurgical, and Petroleum Engineers]] and [[The Minerals, Metals and Materials Society]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Cunningham|first1=Jana|last2=Purser|first2=Annalisa|title=Jan D. Miller receives 2015 Rosenblatt Prize {{!}} University of Utah News|url=https://archive.unews.utah.edu/news_releases/jan-d-miller-receives-2015-rosenblatt-prize/|accessdate=19 March 2017|publisher=University of Utah}}</ref> In 2003 he was recognized by [[Gdańsk University of Technology]] with the ''Medal za Zasługi dla PG'' for special meritorious contributions for the University, and received an [[honorary doctorate]] in 2010. He was also recognized by [[American Institute of Mining, Metallurgical, and Petroleum Engineers|SME]] by a special symposium and proceedings in his honor at the 2005 Annual Meeting.<ref>{{cite web|title=Jan D. Miller|url=http://www.aimehq.org/programs/award/bio/jan-d-miller|website=American Institute of Mining, Metallurgical, and Petroleum Engineers|accessdate=19 March 2017}}</ref>
